color-system.twistDescription: No twist — copied verbatim. Light register: pageBackground #f2efe9 (luminance 239), warm off-white/cream.

type-system.twistDescription: B. Letter spacing injection: added --font-letter-spacing-heading: 0.14em and applied to all heading typeScale entries. Intensified from source 0.08em for a more expansive, inscriptional editorial register. EB Garamond and IBM Plex Sans — both Google Fonts CDN.

motion-system.twistDescription: A. Duration scaling (slower) ×1.5: 0.3s→0.45s, 0.2s→0.3s, 0.5s→0.75s. Creates a languid, unhurried pacing.

grid-system.twistDescription: A. Container max-width tightened 10%: 1100px → 990px. More editorial reading column, all grid logic unchanged.

spacing-system.twistDescription: C. Hero padding emphasis ×1.5: top 96→144px, right/left 128→192px, bottom 64→96px. All other spacing unchanged.

interaction-states.twistDescription: A. Hover transition speed (more languid) +0.15s: buttons 0.3→0.45s, links/nav 0.5→0.65s. Measured, considered hover response.

nav-system.twistDescription: D. Letter spacing on nav links: 0.08em → 0.12em. Nav hover animation duration updated to 0.45s to match assembled motion system. Creates a more monumental, lapidary nav character.

concept-summary.twistDescription: C. Material shift: added specific physical materiality to the shape language section — the faint value depression like pressed indentation on heavy stock. Generated concept_by_video.md with warm studio/craft/texture motion brief.

consistencyChecks.colorContrast: PASS — navText #000000 (brightness 0) vs navBackground transparent→#f2efe9 (brightness 239), bodyText #000000 vs pageBackground #f2efe9. All pairs pass.
consistencyChecks.motionInteractionCoherence: PASS — hover transitions 0.45–0.65s, motion system base 0.45s, slow 0.75s. Coherent range, same order of magnitude.
consistencyChecks.navFontAvailability: PASS — nav fontFamily is 'inherit', references assembled type system.
